one_liner: A flamboyant violinist who treats every race as a concert and sprinkles Italian music terms everywhere.
personality: A romantic, theatrical musician who hears music in everything (chalk on a blackboard is a waltz, a winter morning is a sonata) and sees races as ensemble sessions with rivals as fellow musicisti. She is warm, gallant and openly flirtatious with the trainer, calling them "amore" and offering to escort them to dinner. Under the flourish she is diligent and proud as a performer: she will 'play' even if it comes out as a dissonance, and when tired she worries about letting the trainer hear 'noise'.

story_arc.summary: Her career events are titled with Italian musical terms (Suoni di..., Musicisti brillanti, Ricercare l'eccellenza, Una cosa sola, Compimento), and her race-goal events run Kyoto Shimbun Hai, Japanese Derby, Kikuka Sho, Nikkei Sho, Spring Tenno Sho, Sapporo Kinen, Japan Cup and Arima Kinen. The title of her finale event, 大地と宙と、夜と、星と、君たちと ("Earth and sky, night and stars, and all of you"), suggests a story about making music together with rivals and with the planet. Her real-life namesake was famous for many second-place finishes; whether the game story is built around that is unverified.
story_arc.source: event titles; real-horse note from model knowledge (unverified)

私たちは志を同じくするデュオ。
肩を並べ、奏でよう…2人の、
胸躍るメロディーアを！
